description: Row-relative formulas (running totals / LAG/LEAD / ranks) via SQL window functions. Alteryx Multi-Row Formula equivalent.

expressions.label: Expressions
expressions.description: Map of output_col → {kind: running_total|running_avg|lag|lead|row_number|rank|dense_rank|percent_rank|first_value|last_value|expression, col: <src>, offset: <int>, default: <SQL>, expression: <raw SQL with {col} placeholder>}.

partition_by.description: PARTITION BY columns. Omit for unpartitioned (whole table) window.
partition_by.label: Partition By

order_by.description: ORDER BY columns. Required for ordered window functions (lag/lead/rank/running_*).
order_by.label: Order By

order_descending.description: Per-order_by descending flags. Defaults to all ascending.
order_descending.label: Order Descending

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column holding each row's date. A time-partitioned run reads only the source rows in its window and replaces only those rows of the output, so the output must keep this column.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column holding each row's partition key (static/dynamic partitions). A run reads only its key's rows and replaces only those rows of the output.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_column_type.label: Partition Column Type
partition_column_type.description: 'timestamp' (default) or 'date': the type of partition_date_column, which decides how the window is compared (UTC).

partition_output_column.label: Partition Output Column
partition_output_column.description: Column of the output table that identifies a row's partition (default: partition_date_column / partition_static_column). Set it when the transform renames or derives that column.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds

include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (sample rows) for builder UIs.
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True.
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.
